**Design it, build it, and own it in production.**

Anyone can draw a system diagram. What sets great architects apart is what happens after: whether the design holds when traffic grows tenfold, whether security survives a real audit, and whether teams can still build on it two years later.

Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms in FinTech, Healthcare, AI, SaaS, and more, including our own products **JustInterview.ai** (AI hiring) and **Sparrow** (API testing). * **Grow leaders:** Mentor senior engineers and develop future tech leads.

* **Days 31–60:** Lead a significant design decision from proposal to production and take a visible role in design reviews.
* **Days 61–90:** Introduce standards or patterns that teams adopt, and become the go-to technical authority on a core platform.

* Strong hands-on Node.js and React (MERN preferred) with TypeScript
* Solid cloud architecture experience on AWS, GCP, or Azure

* Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)

* **Real influence:** Set engineering standards for an 80+ engineer team.
* **Fast path to production:** Your designs ship quickly and reach real users.
* **Global team:** Engineers across India, Dubai, and the US.

About the Company

Revenue Optics is a US-based commercial growth firm. We help private equity-backed B2B distributors and industrial companies build stronger revenue engines. We work directly with CEOs, chief revenue officers, commercial leaders and private equity operating partners at companies with $200 million to more than $10 billion in annual revenue.

* Sales transformation: building and scaling proactive inside sales organizations.
* Talent solutions: recruiting high-impact sales and commercial leadership talent.
* Pricing and revenue growth management: finding and capturing margin and revenue opportunities.
* Data, analytics and AI: uncovering revenue opportunities and deploying AI-enabled commercial solutions.

The firm is led by Ali Hasham, a 26-year distribution operator who scaled inside sales from 0 to 90+ reps across 400+ branches at WESCO, TruckPro and Motion Industries.

About the Role

This is a senior, hands-on design role that sits across two teams: Marketing and AI Products & Solutions. About 60% of your time goes to marketing: sales decks, campaign assets, social graphics and long-form reports for senior executives. The other 40% goes to AI Products & Solutions: designing dashboards, interfaces and prototypes for our AI products.

What ties both together is one skill: taking complex ideas, data and workflows and making them obvious to the person looking at them, whether that is a CRO reading a slide or a pricing manager using a dashboard.

We build a lot with AI and keep optimizing on top of it. Designers who build well with AI are highly preferred: people who use it to create templates, systems and workflows so production scales and more of their time goes to work that needs real design judgment.

You'll work directly with the Director of Growth Marketing and the Director of AI Products & Solutions. Briefs will give you the content and a high-level direction; we rely on your judgment to decide how best to show it.

Responsibilities

Visual storytelling (both teams)

* Turn complex ideas, research, statistics, frameworks and workflows into visuals that make the key message obvious in seconds.
* Decide what the single most important point is on every slide, page, post or screen, and design so the user can't miss it.
* Design charts, tables, diagrams and data-dense views that are easy to read, and check every figure against the source.

Product design (AI Products & Solutions)

* Design dashboards, screens and interfaces for our AI products, from understanding the user and the business goal to flows, wireframes, prototypes and final UI.
* Apply strong UX fundamentals: user journeys, information architecture, interaction design, usability and responsive layouts.
* Translate business requirements into practical, usable solutions, and push back when a requirement will hurt the user.
* Build high-fidelity designs, interactive prototypes and reusable components in Figma.
* Use AI prototyping tools (Lovable, Bolt or similar) to validate ideas quickly before engineering builds them.
* Hand off clean, build-ready specs to engineers, stay close during development, and resolve issues so the shipped product matches the design.

Sales decks and collateral (Marketing)

* Own our sales decks: design new decks on request and keep existing decks current as our services, results and team change.
* Build and maintain PowerPoint master templates, layouts and slide libraries that the sales team can edit without breaking the design.
* Design one-pagers, case studies, capability sheets and proposals.

Social, campaign and long-form (Marketing)

* Design LinkedIn graphics, carousels, banners and ad creatives for the company page and leadership profiles, in line with the content calendar.
* Create campaign assets for email, webinars, events, landing pages and the website.
* Design white papers, ebooks and reports using reusable layout templates, consistent from cover to last page.

AI-powered production

* Use AI tools where they help with concepting, image generation, layout variation, editing and production.
* Build reusable templates, prompt libraries and workflows (for example automated resizing, on-brand variations, faster deck and social builds) that make the whole team faster.
* Keep AI output on-brand and consistent across a series, and know when a custom design is the better choice.

Brand and product design systems

* Own the Revenue Optics brand system for marketing: color, typography, iconography, imagery, chart styles and layout.
* Build and maintain a separate design system for our AI products: components, patterns and data-dense UI built for software. It can draw on the brand but is designed for product use.

76ef59050c57.title: Manager, SOX PMO - Business Process

76ef59050c57.description:
**Job Summary**   

As Manager, SOX PMO - Business Process, you'll lead Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance for assigned business processes as part of GitLab's second line. This is advisory work, not repeatable testing: you'll deeply understand how processes work, evaluate risks as the business changes, and help control owners design and remediate controls that hold up to audit. Judgment matters more than procedure. You'll form well-supported conclusions, align with control owners and Internal Audit, and defend positions to external auditors. GitLab already uses AI extensively, and the next phase brings AI agents into our SOX processes. You'll help teams adopt them with confidence, finding creative ways to enable new ways of working while maintaining compliance. You'll also partner with the information technology (IT) SOX PMO on readiness for new systems and applications. This role reports to the Senior Director, SOX PMO, within the Chief Accounting Officers organization.

  
  
**Responsibilities**   

* Lead SOX compliance for assigned business processes as the second-line subject matter expert, advising control owners who own and operate the controls. Deeply understand each process, its systems and data flows, and resolve open questions and assumptions early.
* Monitor risks from new and changing processes, products, and systems. Help control owners design, strengthen, or right-size controls, and contribute to the annual SOX risk assessment and scoping.
* Evaluate control deficiencies individually and in aggregate, identify root causes, and prepare well-supported severity assessments. Work with management to develop, implement, and monitor remediation plans.
* Prepare auditor-ready technical memos on sampling methodology, scoping, and control rationalization, using independent analysis and sound conclusions. Prepare reports and presentations on SOX compliance status for leadership.
* Lead business walkthroughs and stakeholder meetings, and coordinate with Internal Audit and external auditors throughout the audit. Anticipate questions, support positions with data and judgment, and escalate risks and auditor comments promptly with a recommended path forward.
* Advise on controls for AI-enabled processes and processes that use AI agents. Find opportunities to automate SOX work using AI tools, and validate their output.
* Partner with the IT SOX PMO to assess new systems and controls, including application controls and key reports.
* Develop and maintain accurate process narratives, flowcharts, and risk and control matrices as processes change. Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Legal, Human Resources, Sales, Engineering, and IT leaders to help them design and maintain effective business controls.

  
  
**What You'll Bring**   

* Hands-on SOX and internal controls experience in control design, remediation, and deficiency evaluation, beyond testing alone. Experience in the software or technology industry is required; SOX PMO, Big Four risk advisory, or assurance experience is a strong plus.
* A bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; an active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential (strongly preferred) or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) credential.
* A strong understanding of SOX requirements and internal control frameworks, such as the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) framework.
* Professional judgment and skepticism: verifying facts against source documents, testing the reasonableness of data and conclusions, and recognizing missing information.
* A track record of independently solving ambiguous, novel problems, from defining an approach through overcoming obstacles and driving resolution. Curiosity to understand how processes actually work and keep learning as the business changes.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including concise, accurate, auditor-ready memos and actionable recommendations. Confidence partnering with senior stakeholders and external auditors, including working through pushback.
* A practical, innovative approach to helping the business adopt new technologies, products, and ways of working while maintaining compliance. Experience using AI tools to improve efficiency and validating their output.
* Experience with usage-based billing or AuditBoard is a plus.

  
  
**About the team**   

The SOX PMO is part of the Chief Accounting Officers organization. In this role, you'll advise business control owners and partner with the IT SOX PMO, Internal Audit, and external auditors to keep GitLab compliant as processes, systems, and AI use evolve. GitLab is an all-remote company, with flexibility to work from home or wherever you're most productive. You'll need to be available to collaborate with teammates during core US Pacific (PT) and Eastern (ET) business hours.
